entities.summary: Robert Schmidt was a German trade unionist, journalist, politician and member of the Social Democratic Party of Germany. He served as the minister of Reichsernährungsminister (Alimentation), Reichswirtschaftsminister and Reichsminister für Wiederaufbau (Reconstruction) in a number of cabinets of the Weimar Republic.
